title: Thai Beef Stew
description: A hearty Thai-inspired beef stew with rich and savory flavors. Perfect for a cold evening!
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the sliced chili peppers and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the achiote paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew over cooked white rice, garnished with thinly sliced scallions.
Serve with additional chili peppers and achiote paste on the side, if desired.
